official_sources.title: GDAL vector rasterize — cell inclusion and ALL_TOUCHED
official_sources.finding: Default rasterization and ALL_TOUCHED select different boundary pixels; with ALL_TOUCHED, touching-feature input order can change edge pixel values.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster zonal-stats — center, all-touched and fractional pixels
official_sources.finding: Zonal statistics exposes center, all-touched and fractional polygon-pixel coverage semantics; max remains based on intersecting cells rather than coverage-weighted values.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL raster clip — geometry clipping without resampling
official_sources.finding: Geometry clipping preserves the original raster resolution and rounds bounds to whole-pixel locations without resampling; geometry CRS must be explicit when needed.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL raster polygonize — mask and connectivity semantics
official_sources.finding: Polygonization excludes NoData/masked pixels and can switch diagonal connectivity, making connectivity policy part of reverse-check reproducibility.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL vector segmentize — inserted vertices are derived geometry
official_sources.finding: Segmentize inserts intermediate points to enforce a maximum segment length; the output is a derived geometry and must not silently replace canonical parcel coordinates.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: OGC Simple Feature Access Part 1: Common Architecture 1.2.1
official_sources.finding: Simple Features defines geometry classes and associates each geometry with a spatial reference system, providing the baseline model for polygon validity and topological predicates.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: OGC Features and Geometries JSON Part 1: Core 1.0
official_sources.finding: JSON-FG supports CRS other than WGS84 through the place geometry while retaining GeoJSON geometry semantics, so geometry member choice and CRS provenance must be explicit.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: RFC 7946 — GeoJSON precision and uncertainty
official_sources.finding: Coordinate digit count must not be interpreted as uncertainty; GeoJSON itself does not carry an uncertainty model, and coordinate precision choices affect interoperability and size.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL RFC 99 — geometry coordinate precision
official_sources.finding: GDAL can carry explicit XY/Z coordinate resolution metadata and round output coordinates accordingly; serialization precision can therefore modify geometry coordinates.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: OGRGeometry SetPrecision
official_sources.finding: SetPrecision snaps coordinates to a precision grid while attempting to keep the result valid; this is a geometry-changing operation and must be treated as derived.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL GeoJSON driver — RFC 7946 and coordinate precision
official_sources.finding: RFC7946 output reprojects to WGS84, applies right-hand polygon ring rules and defaults to seven decimal places unless precision is controlled; round-trip export can therefore change coordinate representation.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL JSON-FG driver — geometry coordinate precision
official_sources.finding: JSON-FG stores coordinate-resolution metadata for place and geometry members in their respective CRS units, making member-specific precision provenance necessary.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: PROJ FAQ — authority-defined axis order
official_sources.finding: PROJ respects CRS axis order defined by the authority, which can differ from customary GIS x/y ordering.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: PROJ C API quick start — units and axis order
official_sources.finding: Transformation inputs and outputs use the units and axis order of the source and target CRS by default; geographic EPSG CRS can be latitude-first while projected CRS order may vary.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.

official_sources.title: PROJ projections — axis orientation
official_sources.finding: The +axis parameter can alter easting/northing/up orientation, so runtime CRS/axis configuration must be captured rather than assuming ENU.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
official_sources.licence_or_attribution: Official/primary public specification or project documentation; publisher terms apply

official_sources.title: GDAL vector swap-xy — explicit coordinate swap
official_sources.finding: swap-xy explicitly exchanges geometry X and Y coordinates to address axis-order issues; using it is a geometry transformation that must be recorded and never inferred silently.
official_sources.limitation: Preparation evidence only; it does not create canonical parcel coordinates or measured elevation values.
